about: The introitus of the formulary “Transfiguration of Our Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Your lightnings shone upon the world; the earth was moved and trembled. How beloved are Your dwellings, O Lord of hosts! My soul longs and faints for the courts of the Lord. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Your lightnings shone upon the world; the earth was moved and trembled.
